review.evidence: Exact verified source and Ethereum block 26197360 (2026-10-15T10:37:11Z) resolve the current owner, all five owner roles, full deployment-to-pin role-event census, wallet accounts, thresholds and unchanged UUPS implementation. Mint accepts arbitrary uint256 amounts without collateral verification or an economic cap. One administrator signature authorizes unrestricted call/delegatecall and immediate owner-only upgrades. Token transfer fees can be raised by the fee-controller role up to 100%; the pinned rate is 0.01%. Physical reserve reconciliation and exact-controller human/key custody remain undisclosed. MinLaw's published scope is AML/CFT/CPF only, not prudential mint or reserve supervision.
